name: AsyncIterator
description: An AsyncIterator object is an object that conforms to the async iterator protocol by providing a next() method that returns a promise fulfilling to an iterator result object. The AsyncIterator.prototype object is a hidden global object that all built-in async iterators inherit from. It provides a [Symbol.asyncIterator](/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/GlobalObjects/AsyncIterator/Symbol.asyncIterator) method that returns the async iterator object itself, making the async iterator also async iterable.
